name: Dotnet X ASP Web API
description: ASP.NET Core Web API container hosting environment on Ubuntu 24.04 with Nginx reverse proxy, Kestrel systemd services, vsftpd FTP deployment server, and built-in site management CLI utilities (add-dotnet-site, remove-dotnet-site, reset-dotnet-site).

notes.text: FTP credentials for uploading your published project are stored in ~/ftp.creds. Upload your release files directly to /var/www/html.
Includes CLI utilities: 'add-dotnet-site' to add more sites, 'remove-dotnet-site' to delete sites, and 'reset-dotnet-site <name>' to restart/status a site.
